native.globally_quiet: All active UI, Voice and External task owners explicitly held builds/native apps. Voice finished its own pair and replay before handing the native slot directly to UI. Both sequential UI samples ran with no concurrent compiler or native app; read-only ps after sampling confirmed no residual process. Both child processes stopped with intentional SIGINT/exit-2.
native.interpretation: One build and one idle sample per revision. CPU quantized to 0%; small RSS changes are sampling noise, without an improvement claim. Helper child user/system CPU includes ps invocations and is not an application latency metric.

verification.full: Fresh cargo xtask check passed on integrated 9a5c7a0f after all runtime workspace dev packages were invalidated; includes workspace tests, strict Clippy and policy checks.
verification.focused: Actual synthetic timeline regression passed with idle/down/up gestures, duplicate suppression, pending frames, a real older History event, actual message Y restoration within 2px and intentional latest navigation. It failed against the original request predicate. Mixed-height virtualization regression also passed.
verification.standard_package: cargo xtask package passed with normal voice-enabled release flags;206 regular files.
verification.optimized_demo: Normal repository fat-LTO default+demo release build passed in 8m28s; no instrumentation or profile override.

screenshots.reason: No UI design change: the existing upward gesture gains a history request and preserves reading position. The actual rendered-message regression exercises gesture and response; no unrelated synthetic screenshot is presented as a reproduction.

limitations: No live account, service pagination, network or microphone validation.
The common idle demo-chat process sample does not measure active history request or response latency, p95 frame timing, startup or GPU memory.
The comparator differs from the exact integrated parent by unrelated active-server emoji picker ordering, disclosed above.
